title: Surface Area of a Right Circular Cone
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the lateral surface area of the cone z = sqrt(x^2 + y^2) for 0 <= z <= 3.

steps.title: Compute Partial Derivatives and Metric
steps.mathExpression: z_x = \frac{x}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}, \; z_y = \frac{y}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}} \implies 1 + z_x^2 + z_y^2 = 1 + \frac{x^2 + y^2}{x^2 + y^2} = 1 + 1 = 2

steps.title: Integrate Over Base Disk
steps.explanation: Multiply constant sqrt(2) by area of base disk of radius 3.
